recipes.name: Baked Beans
recipes.directions:
Place the beans, bay leaves, water and oil in pressure cooker. Cook at high pressure for 20 minutes. Meanwhile, cook bacon in skillet over medium heat. Remove bacon and drain on paper towel-lined plate. Saute the onions and        garlic in rendered fat until the onions begin to brown around the edges. Stir in the brown sugar, mustard and ketchup. Reserve mixture.
When pressure cooker timer beeps, quick release the pressure. Drain the beans, reserving the liquid. Return the beans and 1-2 cups of liquid to the cooker. Discard any remaining liquid.
Pour reserved mixture on top of the beans. DO NOT STIR!
Cook at high pressure for an additional 10 minutes. Quick release pressure. If the beans are not tender, replace (but do not lock) the lid and simmer until done. Remove bay leaves. Adjust seasonings, if desired.  (Mixture will thicken on standing.)
recipes.reheating_instructions: The day before consumption, remove container from freezer and place in refrigerator to thaw. Heat, covered, in microwave at 70% power for 5 minutes. Stir and continue heating, if necessary, at 1 minute intervals.
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2  cup(s) navy beans, dried, picked over and rinsed
2  bay leaves
6  cup(s) water
1  tablespoon(s) oil
3  bacon slices, chopped
1  large onion, coarsely chopped
2  large garlic cloves, minced
3/4  cup(s) brown sugar
1/4  cup(s) mustard, spicy brown, or more, to taste
3/4  cup(s) ketchup
1  teaspoon(s) salt, or to taste

recipes.name: Barbecued Beef Sandwiches II
recipes.directions:
Place ingredients into pressure cooker.  Cook at high pressure for 45 minutes and  release pressure naturally.

Reserve 2 cups of cooking liquid. Allow meat to cool slightly on cutting board. Chop or shred beef. Add cooking liquid and barbecue sauce a little at a time until mixture is at desired consistency.
recipes.ingredients:
2  pound(s) chuck roast
2  liter(s) soda, Pepsi
5  garlic cloves, slightly smashed
1/4 cup liquid smoke
1  large onion, quartered
Sweet Baby Ray's barbecue sauce
4  hamburger buns

recipes.name: Barbecued Pork Ribs
recipes.directions:
Slice the ribs into single ribs.

Place ingredients into pressure cooker (not BBQ sauce).  Arrange the ribs so that none are directly on top of each other.  (You can lean some ribs against the side of the cooker, but do not fill the cooker more than 2/3 full.)  Cook at high pressure for 15 minutes and quick release pressure.

Drain and cool. Put in bowl with some sauce and toss

Transfer the ribs to a rack set over a foil-lined baking sheet.  Brush the barbecue sauce on both sides of the ribs. 

package/label ribs-
recipes.description: Tender and moist, ready to be slathered with your favorite barbecue sauce!
recipes.reheating_instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees.  Roast until browned and crisp on top, 5-7 minutes.  Turn ribs over and baste with additional sauce.  Continue to roast until second side is deeply browned, about 3 minutes more. Remove from oven and brush a little extra sauce onto each rib.
recipes.ingredients:
1  large onion, quartered
2 tablespoons smoked paprika
5  garlic cloves, slightly smashed
2  liter(s) soda, Pepsi (not diet!)
2  baby back pork ribs, slabs
BBQ sauce
Pressure cooker

recipes.name: Boeuf Bourguignon
recipes.directions:
Cook bacon in pressure cooker until browned and crisp, about 3 minutes. Using slotted spoon, transfer bacon to paper towel-lined plate. Add tomato paste and thyme to fat left in pot and cook until fragrant, about 30 seconds.

Stir in flour and cook for 1 minute. Whisk in wine, smoothing out any lumps, and simmer until thickened, about 10 minutes. Stir in broth, mushrooms, and bay leaves. Using wooden spoon, scrape up all browned bits stuck on bottom of pot. Pat beef dry with paper towels, season with salt and pepper, and stir into pot.

Lock pressure cooker lid in place and cook at high pressure for 35 minutes. Turn the cooker off immediately after the pressurized cooking time and release pressure naturally for 15 minutes. Quick release any remaining pressure, then carefully remove lid. Simmer the stew for 15 minutes to thicken and drive off any remaining raw wine flavor using the browning (not simmer) setting.
Meanwhile, bring pearl onions, water, butter, sugar and 1/4 teaspoon salt to boil in 12" non-stick skillet over high heat. Cover, reduce heat to medium-low, and simmer, shaking pan occasionally, until onions are tender, about 5 minutes. Uncover, increase heat to high, and simmer until all liquid evaporates and onions caramelize, about 3 minutes.

Remove and discard bay leaves from stew. Using large spoon, skim excess fat from surface of stew. Stir in onions, parsley and cognac, and season with salt and pepper to taste. Place reserved bacon in separate container.
recipes.ingredients:
2  bacon slices, chopped fine
2  tablespoon(s) tomato paste
1  teaspoon(s) thyme, dried
1/3  cup(s) all-purpose flour
2  cup(s) Pinot Noir
1  cup(s) beef broth
8  ounce(s) cremini mushrooms, trimmed and sliced thin
2  bay leaves
3  pound(s) beef short ribs, boneless, trimmed and cut into 2" pieces
salt and pepper
2  cup(s) pearl onions, frozen
1/2  cup(s) water
1  tablespoon(s) butter, unsalted
1  tablespoon(s) sugar
2  tablespoon(s) parsley, fresh, minced
1  tablespoon(s) Cognac

recipes.name: Braciole
recipes.directions:
Combine breadcrumbs and parsley. Add 1 tablespoon of olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Lay out flank steak (pound it if it’s a bit thick). Season the steak with salt and pepper.
Place the provolone on the steak. Sprinkle with bread crumb mixture.
Starting at the short end, roll up the steak to enclose the filling. Tie with butcher’s twine. Set the multi-cooker on BROWN and sear the meat on all sides in the remaining olive oil.
Add white wine and marinara. Close and lock the lid of the multi-cooker and set the regulator knob to PRESSURE.
recipes.ingredients:
1/4  cup(s) bread crumbs, Italian
1  garlic clove, minced
1/3  cup(s) Parmesan cheese, grated
2  tablespoon(s) Italian parsley, chopped
3  tablespoon(s) olive oil
salt and pepper
4  Provolone cheese slices
1 1/2  pound(s) flank steaks
1  cup(s) dry white wine
3 1/4  cup(s) Marinara sauce
butcher's twine

recipes.name: CHAI CREME BRULEE
recipes.directions:
1. Preheat the oven to 300°F. Place four 6-ounce shallow ramekins on a rimmed baking sheet. 

2. In a medium pot, bring the heavy cream and the tea to a simmer over medium heat. Once the cream comes to a simmer, remove the mixture from the heat and let it steep for 15 minutes.

3. Strain the cream (or remove the tea bags), then return it to a simmer over medium heat.

4. While the cream comes to a simmer, whisk the egg yolks with the sugar and vanilla extract in a medium bowl.

5. Once the cream comes to a simmer, pour it gradually into the egg mixture, whisking constantly to combine.

6. Ladle the mixture into the ramekins, filling them almost to the top. Transfer the baking sheet to the oven, then pour hot water into the baking sheet so it comes about halfway up the ramekins. 

7. Bake until the custard appears set at the surface but jiggles slightly when shaken, 30 to 35 minutes. Cool the custard to room temperature (about 45 minutes), then refrigerate until completely chilled (at least 1 hour).

8. When ready to serve, sprinkle 1 tablespoon sugar on top of each custard, then shake the ramekin slightly to make sure the sugar is evenly distributed across the surface. Use a torch to brown the sugar into a caramel coating.
Serve immediately.
recipes.ingredients:
1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract
1/2 cup sugar, plus more for finishing
5 egg yolks
3 tablespoons loose chai tea 
2 cups heavy cream

recipes.name: Chamomile Twist Tea Cake
recipes.directions:
Preheat oven to 325 degrees F/convection or 350 degrees F regular. Spray a 4-loaf pan with non-stick baking spray.

In a mini food processor, combine the oats & tea. Grind until fine. Combine in a large bowl with remaining dry ingredients.

In a separate bowl, whisk the wet ingredients until well combined. Add the wet ingredients into the dry and fold until blended and the batter is thick (don’t over work the batter or the cake will be dense and rubbery. Divide batter between each loaf pan. 

Make a glaze: If you have a little extra loose-leaf Chamomle Mango, brew 1 TBS per package instructions. Mix 1 TBS of honey with 1 TBS of the brewed tea (or substitute water), then brush over top of the batter. Sprinkle with extra oats to garnish.

Bake 35 mins, or until the tops are golden brown and a cake tester comes out clean. Cool in pan about 10 mins (until cakes begin to pull away from sides) then turn out onto a wire rack to cool.
recipes.ingredients:
2 TBS TT Chamomile Mango tea
1 tsp Penseys Florida Spice Blend
1/2 cup old-fashioned rolled oats (not quick cooking), 
plus additional for top of bread
2 cups all purpose flour
1 cup whole grain flour (whole wheat or oat flour)
1 tsp baking powder
1/2 tsp baking soda
2 eggs, lightly beaten
3/4 cup buttermilk
1/2 cup honey, plus additional to glaze batter
1/4 cup butter, melted

recipes.name: Cherry Shortbread Cookies
recipes.directions:
Preheat oven to 350°.  Beat butter, sugar and vanilla in a large bowl with electric mixer on medium speed until light and fluffy.  Add flour; mix well.

Stir in 1 c. chocolate chips and cherries.  Drop rounded tablespoons of dough, 2 inches apart onto ungreased cookie sheet.  Flatten each ball of dough slightly.

Bake 10-14 minutes or until lightly browned.  Cool 5 minutes on baking sheets.  Remove to wire racks; cool completely.

In a small bowl, melt 1 c. white chocolate chips in the microwave until melted. Dip half of each cookie into melted white chocolate. Allow to dry before serving.
recipes.ingredients:
2 c. butter, softened
1 c. sugar
2 t. vanilla
4 c. flour
2 c. white chocolate chips
11/2 c. dried cherries

recipes.name: Chicken Artichoke Cassoulet
recipes.directions:
1.	Preheat oven to 350°F.  Heat a heavy, large ovenproof pot over medium heat.  Add the bacon and cook until rendered, about 10 minutes.  Remove cooked bacon and pour off all by 1 tablespoon of fat (reserve the extra bacon fat).    Add the kielbasa or sausage slices and cook for about 10 minutes until browned, stirring occasionally.  Add sausage to the bacon and set aside.

2.	Season the chicken pieces with salt and pepper and then brown them on all sides in the pot over medium heat, adding a little olive oil or bacon fat as needed.  Remove chicken from the pot and add to the bacon/sausage mixture.  

3.	Add onion, carrot and celery to the pot, adding a little more olive oil if needed and a pinch of salt.  Sauté for about 3 minutes until the onion begins to be translucent.  Add the artichokes and garlic and sauté for 2 minutes more.  Stir in the tomato paste.  Add the chicken broth, sausage, chicken, bacon, beans, thyme sprigs, and bay leaves.  Bring to a boil and reduce heat to a simmer.
 
4.	Cover pot and transfer to the preheated oven.  Bake for 40 minutes.  While cassoulet is baking, mix bread with parsley, thyme leaves and olive oil.  After 40 minutes, remove cover and stir the bread mixture into the pot.  Bake for additional 20 – 30 minutes uncovered, occasionally pressing the bread into the mixture to thicken the cassoulet.

5.	Remove from oven and cool slightly.  Add chopped tomato if using and check for seasoning.  Ladle into bowls for serving.  Garnish with parsley and a drizzle of olive oil if desired.

Note:  Chicken-apple sausage or other type of poultry sausage can be used in place of turkey kielbasa or sausage.  Serving suggestions:  crusty baguette and salad.
recipes.ingredients:
2 slices smoked bacon, chopped in 1/2-inch pieces (or use 2 tablespoons olive oil)
14 ounces smoked turkey kielbasa or sausage, cut into 1/2-inch slices
6 large boneless, skinless chicken thighs, chopped into 1-inch pieces 
1 large onion, chopped small dice (about 11/2 cups)
2 medium carrots, chopped small dice
2 stalks celery, chopped small dice (optional)
1 bag or box frozen artichokes (about 10 ounces), thawed & quartered
3 cloves garlic, minced 
1-2 tablespoons tomato paste
4 cups chicken broth (homemade is always preferred)
2 (15-ounce) cans Great Northern beans or similar type, rinsed & drained
3 large sprigs fresh thyme
2 bay leaves
2 - 3 cups country-style bread, crust removed, very small cubes
1/4 cup fresh parsley plus more for garnish
1 tablespoon fresh thyme leaves
2 tablespoons olive oil
2 Roma tomatoes, peeled, seeded & chopped (optional)

recipes.name: Chocolate Tea Gelatina
recipes.directions:
In a large bowl, sprinkle the gelatin over the Crème de Cacao liqueur. Let stand until the gelatin softens about 5 minutes.

Meanwhile boil 1 ¾ cups of water. Pour boiled water over 3 teaspoons of either Chocolate Tea by Tealightful* and ½ teaspoon of unsweetened dark cocoa powder.
Brew for 5 minutes stirring occasionally. Strain the tea. Add to the gelatin the hot tea mixture, sugar and salt. Stir until gelatin dissolves and liquid is clear. Pour into 4 dessert dishes. Refrigerate for 2 ½ – 3 hours.  Top with sweetened whip cream and garnish with grated dark chocolate.
Sweetened Whipped Cream
Pour 4 ounces of heavy cream in a bowl. Add ½ teaspoon of Crème de Cacao liqueur, ½ teaspoon vanilla extract, ½ teaspoon white sugar. Beat until firm and cream forms peaks.
recipes.ingredients:
2 1/2 teaspoons of unflavored gelatin
1/3 cup of Crème de Cacao liqueur
1 1/2 cups of strong Chocolate Tea by Tealightful* 
1/2  scant teaspoon of  unsweetened dark cocoa powder 
1/3 cup of white sugar
Pinch of salt
Whipped cream sweetened with Crème de Cacao liqueur, vanilla extract and sugar.
Garnish – grated dark chocolate

recipes.name: Citrus-Tea Salmon
recipes.directions:
1. In a mortar and pestal, coarsly crush the irish breakfast tea. 
2. In a small bowl mix together the curshed tea, orange peel, ginger, sugar, salt and pepper. 
3. In a separate medium bowl, mix egg and lemon juice together. 
4. Drench each salmon fillet in the egg mixture and and place on baking pan. 
5. Sprinkle the Citrus-Tea rub on each and spread evenly to coat each fillet. 
6. Cook in oven for 20 minutes.
recipes.ingredients:
(2) 1 pound King Salmon fillets
1 Tbs. + 1 tsp Irish Breakfast Tea
2 Tbs. dark brown sugar
1 tsp dried orange peel
1/4 tsp ginger powder
1/2 tsp kosher salt
1/4 tsp freshly ground black pepper
1 tsp lemon juice
1 egg, beaten

recipes.name: Coconut Lace Scones
recipes.directions:
Preheat oven to 400°. Combine self-rising flour and sugar. 
Cut in butter until mixture is coarse and crumbly. Mix in coconut and chips. Add just enough of buttermilk mixture to make a soft dough. Scoop out about ⅓ of the dough and form a small disc about ½ inch thick. Cut into 8 pie-shaped pieces. Do this for the remaining dough. Or you can cut scones into shapes with simple shaped cookie cutters. Place on a cookie sheet lined with parchment 
paper and bake until done, about 8-12 minutes. Makes about 24 scones depending on the shape and size.
recipes.ingredients:
3 c. self-rising flour 
1/2 c. sugar 
1/2 c. white chocolate chips 
1 stick unsalted butter 
1 c. buttermilk 
1/2 c. sweetened coconut

recipes.name: Creamy Corn Soup with Dulse
recipes.directions:
In a medium ¬sized soup pot, sauté onion in 2 teaspoons olive oil with a pinch of sea salt for five minutes. 
Add sweet corn and sauté for 2 more minutes. 
Add enough water just to cover vegetables and simmer for 10 minutes. 
Blend with an immersion blender or vitamix until smooth. 
In a cast iron skillet, pan-fry dulse in 1 teaspoon olive oil until crispy. Season with sea salt to taste and garnish with pan-fried dulse.
recipes.ingredients:
3 teaspoons extra virgin olive oil, divided 
1 organic yellow onion, finely chopped 
Sea salt, to taste (SI brand recommended) 
3 cups fresh or frozen sweet corn kernels 
Filtered or spring water 
1/2 cup dulse, torn into small pieces, for garnish

recipes.name: Darjeeling Sweet Potatoes
recipes.directions:
PREHEAT oven to 400°F. Line a large baking sheet with foil and coat with cooking spray.
IN a large bowl, toss together sweet potatoes and EVOO. Sprinkle Black Pepper, Black Lava Sea Salt, and lime zest over top. Crumble the Darjeeling Tea in your hands and sprinkle over top as well.
TOSS until potatoes are evenly coated.

SPREAD the potatoes evenly on the baking sheet and bake for 10 mins. Flip the potatoes. Continue to bake for an additional 10-20 mins, or until the potatoes brown and are slightly firm. Serve warm.
recipes.ingredients:
1/3 cup Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 tsp  Black Pepper 
1 TBS Black Lava Sea Salt
2 TBS Darjeeling Tea 
3 lbs sweet potatoes, peeled, cut into small wedges
1 TBS lime zest

recipes.name: Dark Chocolate Almond Cake
recipes.directions:
1.	Preheat oven to 350 F.  Prepare one (9 or 10 inch) springform pan but lining the bottom with parchment paper. Coat the paper with cooking spray.

2.	Blend the almonds and ¼ cup sugar using a food processor until the almonds are finely ground.  Chop the chocolate and add to the mixture.  Blend until finely ground, scraping the sides of the bowl.  

3.	In a large bowl, cream the butter and remaining 1¼ cups sugar together.  Add the egg yolks and then beat until thoroughly mixed.  Add the grated chocolate mixture, cocoa powder, espresso powder, salt, brewed espresso, juice, zest and vanilla.  Mix until just uniform. 

4.	In a medium bowl, beat the egg whites with an electric mixer until stiff peaks form.  Gently fold the egg whites into the batter, and then pour the batter into the pan.  Bake for 50-60 minutes or until the cake springs back when lightly touched in the center.  Remove from the oven and cool on a wire rack completely before cutting.  Serve with unsweetened whipped cream or ice cream and cherry sauce.  

Red Wine Cherry Sauce (optional):
Add 1 cup red wine to a sauté pan and let it reduce to ¼ of its volume over medium heat.  Whisk in 2 tablespoons honey and add 2 cups frozen, thawed dark cherries and 1 tablespoon orange zest.  Mash slightly and set aside to macerate.  Serve over cake or ice cream.
recipes.ingredients:
2 1/2 cups toasted almonds
1 1/2 cups granulated sugar, divided
3 ounces dark chocolate (at least 60%)
1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, at room temperature
6 large eggs, whites and yolks separated
2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder
1 teaspoon instant espresso powder
1/2 teaspoon fine sea salt
1/4 cup brewed espresso, cold
2 tablespoons fresh orange juice
Zest of 1 orange
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
1 cup heavy cream for whipping or 1 pint good vanilla ice cream

recipes.name: Devonshire Cream
recipes.directions:
This is not a “true” Devonshire cream, but our customers love our version.

In a small bowl with an electric mixer, beat cream cheese, lemon juice, and vanilla.  Gradually beat in powdered sugar.  Fold in sour cream. Makes 1½ cup
recipes.ingredients:
1 8 oz. pkg. softened cream cheese
2 c. powdered sugar
1/2 freshly squeezed lemon
2 t. vanilla
1 c. sour cream

recipes.name: Earl Grey Oatmeal
recipes.directions:
Earl Grey Oatmeal with Blueberries

1.	Bring the oats, salt, and liquids to a boil on the stove.
2.	Cook and stir until the oats begin absorbing the liquid, and start to thicken.
3.	Leave to thicken for about 2 minutes, or until the oatmeal is plump and fragrant from the tea.
4.	Stir in the vanilla, zest, and sweetener.
5.	When the desired consistency is reached, add in about half the blueberries so that they warm up and begin to give off color.
6.	Remove from heat, transfer to a bowl or dish, and add in the rest of the berries.
7.	Drizzle with the syrup, top with extra zest, and enjoy.

Chamomile Syrup

1.	Boil the water and salt in a small pot over high heat.
2.	Once the water is bubbling rapidly, add in the sugar and stir until it dissolves.
3.	Continue cooking for a few more minutes, until the mixture has thickened a bit on your spoon.
4.	Turn off the heat.
5.	Add the chamomile, and let steep, covered, for about 15-20 minutes, or until the desired strength is reached.
6.	Give it a stir every few minutes, upsetting the flowers.
7.	Strain the mixture through a fine sieve or mesh, pressing the liquid from the flowers down with the back of a spoon.
8.	Best served warm.
9.	Store refrigerated, in an airtight container or jar for about one week.
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup water
1 cup sugar, or dry soluble sweetener
Pinch of salt
About 3/4 cup, more or less, dried organic chamomile, or 2-3 chamomile tea bags (use more or less to preferred strength)
1/2 cup oats
Pinch of salt
3/4 cup prepared Earl Grey tea, steeped to your preferred strength
1/2 cup milk of choice, or water
1/4 tsp. vanilla
1/4 tsp. orange or lemon zest, plus more to top
1 tbsp. honey, maple syrup, or sweetener of choice
Handful of blueberries, or berries of your choice
Chamomile syrup to top (optional)

recipes.name: Earl Grey Shish Kebab
recipes.directions: Bring water to a boil and pour over tea bags in a mug for 5 minutes. Squeeze and remove tea bags. Stir in remaining ingredients and cool to room temperature.  Pour tea infusion over meat and marinate for 1 hour.  Assemble skewers, alternating meat and vegetables. Barbecue or cook in oven, turning skewers and frequently applying remaining marinade juice.
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup water
4 tea bags Aged Earl Grey
juice from 1 lemon
1 tbsp. honey
salt and pepper
1 pound beef or chicken cut into kebab chunks
1 medium red onion
1 red or yellow pepper
1 green pepper
4 shish kebab skewers

recipes.name: Earthy Grilled Chicken
recipes.directions:
Combine rub ingredients and grind until fine. 
Rub chicken breasts with olive oil and then rub with a coating of the rub.
recipes.reheating_instructions: Grill as desired
recipes.ingredients:
2 tbs tea leaves  (Pu Erh)
two tablespoons Kosher Salt, 
two tablespoons Whole cumin seeds, 
two tablespoons smoked paprika
Olive oil
2 split Chicken breasts (bone in---not for Brownes!)

recipes.name: Easy Almond Tart Crust
recipes.directions:
Place almonds in food processor fitted with the S- blade and pulse until you have a course meal. Add the dates and process until the mixture begins to stick together. Be careful not to over process.  
To test, place a spoonful of the crust in the palm of your hand and squeeze gently, break in half. If the halves hold together well and do not crumble the crust is finished. If it is crumbly pulse briefly to desired consistency. Do not over process or the oil will separate from the crust.  
Press into a 9-inch pie pan or tart pan, and chill the crust in the freezer for 15 minutes. 
Variations:  
Add 1 teaspoon dry shredded coconut  
Add the seeds from half of a vanilla bean for aroma and flavor.
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups almonds, soaked and dehydrated
6-8 medjool dates, pitted and chopped 
pinch unrefined sea salt

recipes.name: Everyday Kitchari
recipes.directions:
Soak split mung or urud dal 3-4 hours. Bring about 6 cups of water to a boil in a kettle. Use a large sauce pan. If using onion or leeks, heat 2 teaspoons of ghee or oil on medium flame until it shimmers add onion and sauté until tender.  

Push onion to the sides of the pan to make a well, turn down heat. Add another teaspoon of oil to the well and heat until it shimmers then add the mustard seeds and cover with a splatter screen. Stir seeds as needed until they pop and turn gray. Once mustard seeds are 80 percent popped, remove from heat and add the fenugreek, clove, ginger and turmeric followed by the other ground spices. Stir until golden and fragrant. 

Stir in the drained beans and rice; coat in the toasted spices. Add any root vegetables, potatoes, carrots or heavy greens. Carefully add about 4 cups of boiling water. Return to a boil, turn down and let simmer for 30 minutes or until kitchari is soupy and rice and mung are well cooked. Add more boiling water as needed. 

In the final 10-15 minutes of simmering add fast-cooking, sweeter vegetables such as light-weight greens, edible-pod peas, green beans or celery. 

In general, seasonal condiments are provided so that each person can garnish their serving according to the desired seasonal, healing or dosha effect.
recipes.ingredients:
1/2 cup split yellow mung or split urud dal  
3/4 cup rice basmati rice Ghee or sesame oil 
1/2 cup onion or leek, chopped, optional 
1/2 teaspoon mustard seeds 
1/4 teaspoon fenugreek seeds, whole 
3 cloves, whole 
1 teaspoon fresh turmeric, finely minced (or 1/2 teaspoon powdered turmeric) 
2 teaspoons fresh ginger, finely minced (or 1 teaspoon of powdered ginger) 
2 teaspoons cumin seed, freshly ground 
2 teaspoons fennel seed, freshly ground 
2 teaspoons coriander seed, freshly ground 
1 cup vegetables, diced 
6 cups water, divided

recipes.name: Flourless Chocolate Chai Cake
recipes.directions:
1. Preheat oven to 300 degrees (F). Grease a 10 inch round cake pan. 

2. Combine tea and sugar in a small saucepan. Heat, stirring, until sugar completely dissolves. 

3. In a microwave safe bowl, combine chocolate and butter. Microwave at 50% power until melted, stirring every 45 seconds. 

4. With an electric mixer, slowly beat the sugared tea into the melted chocolate mixture. Add the eggs, one at a time while mixing. 

5. Pour the batter into prepared pan. place the pan in a larger pan, and fill with water to half up the round pan's sides. Be careful not to splash water into the cake batter. 

6.Bake both pans nestled together in preheated oven for 45 minutes. Chill the cake in the pan for 6-8 hours or overnight. Unmold the cake by dipping the bottom of the cold pan in hot water for 15 seconds, then invert the pan onto a serving tray. Serve immediately or cover and refrigerate the remainder.
recipes.ingredients:
1/2 Cup strong brewed Masala Chai tea
3/4 Cup white sugar
18 oz bittersweet chocolate (chopped or chips)
2 sticks (1 Cup) salted butter, sliced into tablespoon portions
6 eggs

recipes.name: Gluten-Free Earl Grey Shortbread Cookies
recipes.directions:
Preheat oven to 350˚ Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Mix rice flour, baking powder and salt in a medium-sized bowl.
Cut tops off tea bags and pour into bowl; stir to combine.
In a large mixing bowl, cream butter and sugar until fluffy. Add egg yolks and vanilla, beating until combined. Gradually fold in the dry ingredients, mixing well until a soft dough forms.
Roll tablespoon-sized balls of dough between your palms and lightly press onto lined baking sheet.

Bake 10-12 minutes or until edges begin to brown.
Allow to cool on tray for a few minutes before removing to a wire rack to cool completely
recipes.ingredients:
1-1/3 cup rice flour
1 teaspoon baking powder
1/4 teaspoon salt
6 Earl Grey tea bags or 6 teaspoons of loose-leaf
8 tablespoons (1 stick) unsalted butter, softened
1/2 cup sugar
2 large egg yolks
1 teaspoon vanilla extract

recipes.name: Gnocchi alla Sorrentina
recipes.directions:
Remove tomatoes from can and place in a large bowl, reserving juices. Crush tomatoes using your hands; remove and discard the hard core from stem end, and any skin and tough membrane; set aside, or a few quick pulses in a food processor to break down the tomatoes.

Place oil in a large, nonreactive saucepan over medium-low heat. Add onion, and cook until soft and just beginning to brown, about 3 minutes. Stir in garlic, and cook until softened, about 30 seconds. Stir in tomatoes and reserved juices; season with salt. Increase heat and bring to a boil. Immediately reduce heat to low and simmer until slightly thickened, about 1 hour.
Stir in ½ of the basil, and season with pepper; continue cooking 1 minute more. 
When you are ready to serve the gnocchi, bring 6 quarts of water to a boil and add 2 tablespoons salt.

Drop the gnocchi into the boiling water and cook until floating aggressively, 4 to 5 minutes. Carefully transfer the gnocchi to the pan with the sauce, using a slotted spoon. Turn the heat to medium and toss gently for about 30 seconds. Tear the basil leaves into a few pieces and add to the sauce along with the mozzarella cubes. Toss together for 30 seconds longer. Pour into a heated bowl and serve immediately, or place into gratin dish and bake until hot bubbly and cheese is melted.
recipes.ingredients:
4 28 ounce whole tomatoes with basil, preferably from San Marzano 
1/2 cup olive oil 
6 tablespoons minced onion 
4 cloves garlic, peeled and minced 
Coarse salt and freshly ground pepper 
15-20 leaves fresh basil, torn, divided 
1 pound fresh mozzarella di bufala, cut into 1/4" diced 
3 pounds homemade potato gnocchi

recipes.name: Green Rooibos Potato Gratin
recipes.directions:
Bring 5 Cups of water to a rolling boil with salt and teabags. Cut unpeeled potatoes into quarters and add to tea liquid. Boil for approximately 30 minutes until potatoes are tender.
Drain potatoes well. Mash with a fork in an oven proof casserole dish with olive oil, cheese, salt and pepper. Bake for 30 minutes until golden brown.
recipes.ingredients:
6 bags of Green Rooibos
1/2 tsp. salt
4 medium buttery potatoes, scrubbed & unpeeled
6 tbsp. Olive oil
1 cup grated parmegiano reggiano cheese
Sea salt to taste
Freshly ground black pepper to taste

recipes.name: Greens with Tea Dressing
recipes.directions: Toast tea leaves in a skillet for 2 minutes, shaking to avoid burning. Take skillet off heat and add boiling water. Let steep for 1 minute then strain, saving liquid and discarding leaves. Saute ginger in a few teaspoons of oil, for one or two minutes, stirring to avoid burning. Add tea liquid to skillet and add greens to combine. Cook until wilted and season with salt and pepper. Place greens in a bowl, drizzle with a little of tea and top with goat cheese and fruit pieces. Sprinkle top with a bit more EVOO
recipes.ingredients:
1/4 cup of loose-leaf tea
1 cup of boiling water
1 tablespoon of fresh ginger, peeled and finely chopped
Olive oil
1 1/2 lbs. of any kind of greens, tough stems or ribs removed
Salt & Pepper to taste
5 oz. of soft goat cheese, cubed or sliced into circles
2 ripe nectarines, plums or apricots, pitted and sliced into wedges

recipes.name: Green Tea Chicken Soup Recipe
recipes.directions:
1. Bring 2 quarts of broth to a boil, then turn off the heat and add tea bags. Allow to steep for 10 minutes, then remove tea bags. Strain if using loose-leaf without bags/infuser.
2. Place chicken into pot and bring to a boil again, then turn down to a low simmer for 40 minutes to cook the chicken.
3. With about 20 minutes remaining, add the remaining ingredients.
4. Serve hot or store refrigerated in glass containers for 4-5 days.
recipes.ingredients:
2 quarts chicken broth
6-7 bags of green tea or 6-7 teaspoons of loose-leaf (in a paper tea bag(s) or infuser)
2 tbsp coconut oil
1 red onion, chopped
4 garlic cloves, chopped finely
2 carrots chopped
1 cup chopped celery (about 2 sticks)
1 tsp fresh thyme, chopped
1 bay leaf
2 chicken breasts, chopped into medium sized pieces
2 tsp sea salt
2 tsp black pepper

recipes.name: Heart of Palm & Endive Salad with Lemon Parsley Vinaigrette
recipes.directions:
1.	To make the vinaigrette, place shallot, lemon zest, lemon juice, sugar, mustard & garlic in a small bowl.  Add a pinch of salt and then whisk together.  Add the oil in a stream while whisking until emulsified.  Add parsley and then season to taste with salt & pepper.  Cover & leave at room temperature until ready to serve; remove garlic before serving.  (If making several hours ahead, cover & refrigerate dressing until about 30 minutes before serving.)

2.	For the salad, combine the endive and heart of palm pieces in a medium bowl.  Just before serving, whisk the dressing and pour over the salad, using enough to coat the pieces.  Toss and enjoy immediately. 

Note:  You can add one of these additional ingredients to the salad:  crumbled blue cheese, toasted nuts, chopped apple pieces (leave the skin on for color) or frisée.
recipes.ingredients:
**Salad:
2 large or 3 medium endive heads, rinsed, dried & chopped into 3/4-inch pieces
1 jar or can heart of palm (about 15 ounces), drained & chopped into 1/2-inch pieces
**Vinaigrette:
1 large shallot, finely chopped
1/4 teaspoon lemon zest
1/4 cup fresh lemon juice
1/2 teaspoon sugar or to taste
1/2 teaspoon Dijon mustard
1 or 2 garlic cloves, crushed
1 – 2 tablespoons chopped parsley
1/3 - 1/2 cup extra-virgin olive oil
Kosher or sea salt & freshly-ground black pepper to taste

recipes.name: Heart Shaped Chicken Puff Pastry
recipes.directions:
Thaw pastry sheets about 20-30 minutes. Do not thaw longer or they will be too sticky to use. While pastry is thawing, cut chicken breasts into tiny pieces. Place oil in skillet, add chicken, garlic and other ingredients on the list that sound appealing to you (except cheese and cream cheese). Sauté until chicken is done. Cool slightly. Cut puff pastry into squares or heart shapes. Place on a cookie sheet lined with parchment paper. Add filling, sprinkle with cheese if desired and dot with a cube of cream cheese. Fold over and seal with fingers or fork. For hearts, add a second heart on top and crimp with a fork. At this point you can freeze them if you wish. If you plan on freezing them, freeze directly on cookie sheet first for at least 15 minutes. Then transfer to ziplock freezer bags. When ready to bake, place on a cookie sheet lined with parchment paper. Thaw for about 15 minutes. Brush with beaten egg.

Bake at 400° until golden and puffed (about 10-20 min depending on the size)
recipes.ingredients:
1 package puff pastry 
2 chicken breasts 
1/2 onion, chopped 
1 T. olive oil 
1 garlic clove 
cheese - any kind, I like to use smoked cheddar 
tarragon, fresh, chopped 
mushrooms, chopped 
rosemary, fresh, chopped 
bacon, cooked and finely crumbled 
asparagus, cut into very small pieces, microwave for 1 minute, cool 
green onion, finely chopped 
ham, finely chopped 
cream cheese, cut into dice sized cubes 
beaten egg

recipes.name: Heavenly Creamy Flan
recipes.directions:
Over medium heat, place sugar in small heavy skillet and heat until sugar begins to melt and syrup turns golden.
Immediately pour into a 1-quart baking dish that fits into pressure cooker. Tilt dish in all directions to coat bottom and as much of the sides before syrup stops running; set aside. 
In bowl or blender, mix remaining ingredients until smooth. Pour into prepared baking dish and cover tightly.
Set covered dish into cooker; pour hot water into cooker to come halfway up the sides of the baking dish.
Close lid and cook at high pressure for 9 minutes. Allow pressure to drop naturally.
Take flan out of cooker, cover and refrigerate.
recipes.ingredients:
1/2  cup(s) sugar
1  cup(s) milk
1/8  teaspoon(s) salt
14  ounce(s) condensed milk, sweetened
4  eggs
1  teaspoon(s) vanilla

recipes.name: Herbed Cheese Spread with Olive on Toasts
recipes.directions: Combine all ingredients except the olive oil in a bowl.  Mix together and chill for about 1 hour.  Serve with toast or if you wish, using a 1-tablespoon scoop, shape the herbed goat cheese into smooth balls.  Place in a medium bowl or container and add enough olive oil to cover them.  If possible, make the cheese ahead to allow it to sit for 24 hours so flavors can develop.
recipes.ingredients:
8 ounces goat cheese, softened
2 tablespoons thinly sliced fresh basil
2 tablespoons minced fresh Italian parsley
2 tablespoons finely chopped shallot or sun-dried tomato in oil
1 teaspoon minced fresh thyme
1 teaspoon minced fresh marjoram or oregano
1/2 teaspoon kosher salt
1/8 teaspoon fresh-ground black pepper
1 cup extra-virgin olive oil (optional - if making cheese balls)
Sliced Green pimento-stuffed olives for garnish

recipes.name: Herb-Stuffed Boneless Leg of American Lamb
recipes.directions:
Season the lamb leg inside and out with salt and pepper.  In a small bowl, combine the herbs, zest, oil and garlic.  Stuff the lamb with the herb mixture; tie with kitchen twine.  Brush the outside of lamb with oil.

Place a rimmed baking pan filled with 1 inch of water on lower rack of oven.  Put lamb leg directly on the upper rack, over the other pan so it will catch the drippings.  Roast at 450°F for 20 minutes; reduce heat to 325°F.  Roast until internal temperature is 135°F at the thickest part of the lamb leg, about 1 hour.

Remove lamb to a warm place; allow to rest for at least 30 minutes before carving.
recipes.ingredients:
1 American Lamb leg, boned, rolled and tied
   Salt and pepper, to taste
1 cup chopped fresh herbs (rosemary, thyme, basil, mint, parsley, cilantro in any combination)
2 lemons, zested
1/4	cup olive oil, plus more for brushing
2 tablespoons chopped fresh garlic

recipes.name: Indian Black-eyed Peas
recipes.directions:
In pressure cooker, combine peas, water, salt and oil.  Cook at high pressure for 7 minutes.  Release pressure naturally.
Meanwhile, in Dutch oven, saute ginger and garlic in 1 teaspoon oil.  Add tomatoes and simmer for 5 minutes. Add spices and stir.  Add peas and simmer 5 minutes.  Cool.  Stir in cilantro.
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/4  cup(s) black-eyed peas, dried
4 1/2  cup(s) water
3/8  teaspoon(s) salt
1 1/2  teaspoon(s) oil, (to prevent foaming)
1  teaspoon(s) oil
1  tablespoon(s) ginger root, minced
3  garlic cloves
16  ounce(s) tomatoes, diced, canned
1  onion, chopped
1/2  teaspoon(s) turmeric
1  teaspoon(s) cumin, ground
1  teaspoon(s) coriander, ground
1  teaspoon(s) chili powder
1/2  cup(s) cilantro, chopped
salt, to taste

recipes.name: Indian Butter Chicken
recipes.directions:
Cut the chicken pieces into quarters.
Put tomatoes, jalapeno (use less?) and ginger in a blender or food processor and blend to a fine puree.
Add butter to pressure cooking pot, select Browning. When butter is melted and foam begins to subside, add the chicken pieces, a few at a time, and sear until they are nicely browned all over (about 2­3 minutes per batch). Remove them with a slotted spoon into a bowl and put aside.
Add ground cumin and paprika to the butter in the pot and cook, stirring rapidly, for 10­-15 seconds. Add the tomato mixture, salt, cream, yogurt and chicken pieces (with any juices that have accumulated in the bowl) to the pot. Gently stir the chicken to coat the pieces. Cover and lock lid in place. Select High Pressure and 5 minutes cook time. When timer beeps, turn off and use a natural pressure release for 10 minutes. After 10 minutes use a quick pressure release to release any remaining pressure.
Stir in the garam masala and roasted cumin. Whisk together cornstarch and water in a small bowl. Stir into sauce in the pot. Select sauté and bring to a boil. Turn off pressure cooker and stir in minced cilantro.

Cool, package and label
recipes.reheating_instructions: Reheat on the stove top or in microwave
recipes.ingredients:
10  chicken thighs, boneless, skinless
28  ounce petite dice tomatoes 
1  jalapenos, seeded and chopped
2  tablespoon(s) ginger root, peeled and chopped
1/2  cup butter, unsalted
2  teaspoon cumin, ground
1  tablespoon paprika
2  teaspoon kosher salt
3/4  cup heavy cream
3/4  cup yogurt, Greek
2  teaspoon garam masala
2  teaspoon cumin seeds (roasted and ground) 
2  tablespoon cornstarch
2  tablespoon water
1/4  cup cilantro, firmly packed, minced
coffee grinder

recipes.name: Lamb Cutlets with Summer Vegetables
recipes.directions:
Season the cutlets with salt and pepper.  Dredge first in flour, then egg, then bread crumbs.  In a pan over high heat, heat half the oil.  Sauté the cutlets, without crowding the pan, until browned on each side.  As done, remove to a warm platter.  Add more oil if needed; continue frying the cutlets.

Once all cutlets are done, arrange in a single layer on a serving platter.  Add remaining oil to the pan; add onion, pepper and garlic; cook until softened, stirring often.  Add tomatoes; season with salt and pepper.  Cook until tomatoes are warmed through and starting to soften; add in basil and mint as desired.

Spoon the sauce over the cutlets; serve immediately.
recipes.ingredients:
20	ounces American Lamb cutlets, pounded thin
Salt and pepper, to taste
2	cups flour
2	eggs, beaten
2	cups bread crumbs or Panko
1/2	cup olive oil
1	medium onion, thinly sliced
1	sweet pepper, thinly sliced
1	teaspoon chopped fresh garlic
3	medium tomatoes, chopped
Basil and mint leaves, torn

recipes.name: Lemony Chicken Saltimbocca
recipes.directions:
1. Sprinkle the chicken evenly with salt. Place 2 pieces prosciutto (still on paper) side by side.  Lay on sage leaves.  Lay on Chicken- fold edges of prosciutto over top of chicken.

2. Heat a large skillet over medium heat. Add 1 tablespoon oil to pan, and swirl to coat. Add chicken to pan; Brown quickly. Remove chicken from pan;Cool quickly

3. Combine broth, lemon juice, and cornstarch in a small bowl; stir with a whisk until smooth. Add cornstarch mixture and the remaining 1 teaspoon olive oil to pan; bring to a boil, stirring constantly. Cook for 1 minute or until slightly thickened, stirring constantly with a whisk. Cool.

Place chicken in glass baking dish, Spoon cooled sauce over chicken. Cover with foil, label and refrigerate.
recipes.description: Boneless chicken breasts wrapped in Prosciutto (Italian ham) with sage and a lemony butter sauce, served over fresh pasta.
recipes.reheating_instructions:
Preheat oven to 300.  Heat for 10-15 minutes, until heated through.
(If frozen defrost overnight in the refrigerator)
Cook pasta according to package.
recipes.ingredients:
4 (4-ounce) chicken cutlets (about 1/2 WF cutlet each)
1/8 teaspoon salt
12 fresh sage leaves
6 ounces very thinly sliced prosciutto, cut into 8 thin strips
4 teaspoons extra-virgin olive oil, divided
1/3 cup fat-free, lower-sodium chicken broth
1/4 cup fresh lemon juice
1/2 teaspoon cornstarch (arrow root if frozen)
1 package fresh pasta
2 labels

recipes.name: Mac 'n Cheese (Fagor)
recipes.directions:
Place water and macaroni in pressure cooker.  Cook on high for 5 minutes.
While the macaroni is cooking, combine the evaporated milk, cornstarch, salt, pepper, onion powder and mustard in a small bowl.  When the pressure cooker has finished, quick-release the pressure and carefully remove the lid.  Stir the macaroni to break it up, and then add the milk mixture and the remaining ingredients. Set the pressure cooker to the brown setting and stir until the sauce thickens and the cheese has melted.
recipes.ingredients:
4  ounce(s) cream cheese, room temperature
1  tablespoon(s) butter
1  cup(s) Parmesan cheese, grated
4  ounce(s) Cheddar cheese, sharp
1/2  teaspoon(s) mustard, dry
1/2  teaspoon(s) onion powder
1/2  teaspoon(s) black pepper
1  teaspoon(s) salt
2  tablespoon(s) cornstarch
14 1/2  ounce(s) evaporated milk
3  cup(s) macaroni
3  cup(s) water

recipes.name: Matcha Tea Cake Cookies
recipes.directions:
In a medium bowl, whisk the flour, baking powder, salt and cardamom. 

In another bowl, whisk the granulated sugar, oil, eggs and vanilla and almond extracts. 

In a small bowl, stir 2 tablespoons of the matcha powder with 2 tablespoons of water, then stir into the wet ingredients. Stir the wet ingredients into the flour mixture just until combined.

Using a 1-ounce ice cream scoop or 2 tablespoons, scoop 1-inch balls of dough at least 2 inches apart onto 2 baking sheets lined with parchment paper. Refrigerate for at least 20 minutes.

Preheat the oven to 350°. Bake the cookies for about 10 minutes, until set at the edges and very lightly browned on the bottoms. Let the cookies cool for 10 minutes, then transfer to a rack to cool completely.

Arrange the cookies on 1 baking sheet. In a sieve, combine the confectioners’ sugar with the remaining 1 teaspoon of matcha. Dust over the cookies and serve.

MAKE AHEAD The cookies can be stored in an airtight container for up to 3 days. Dust with the matcha sugar before serving.
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups all-purpose flour
2 teaspoons baking powder
1/2 teaspoon kosher salt
1/8 teaspoon ground cardamom
3/4 cup granulated sugar
2/3 cup canola oil
2 large eggs
1/2 teaspoon pure vanilla extract
1/4 teaspoon pure almond extract
2 tablespoons plus 1 teaspoon matcha tea powder
1/4 cup confectioners’ sugar

recipes.name: Olive Tapenade
recipes.directions: Place the olives, capers, zest, juice & red pepper in the bowl of a food processor and pulse gently until combined.  Mixture should still be chunky.  Fold in the parsley and taste to adjust seasoning.  Place in an airtight container and refrigerate.  Tapenade will last up to 2 weeks.
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup pitted green olives
1/2 cup pitted Kalamata olives
11/2 tablespoons capers, drained & rinsed
Zest and juice of 1 lemon
1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes (or more to taste)
1 tablespoon chopped fresh Italian parsley
2 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil, as needed for consistency

recipes.name: Orange Sesame Ribs
recipes.directions:
Trim fat from ribs.  Lightly coat pressure cooker with cooking spray and turn on BROWN setting. Cook ribs until brown.  Drain off fat.
In a medium bowl, stir together marmalade, hoisin sauce, garlic, and sesame oil.  Pour over ribs in cooker; stir to coat meat with sauce.
Cover and cook on HIGH for 12 minutes.  Transfer meat to storage containers.  Skim fat from sauce.  Spoon some of the sauce over the meat.  Freeze.
Place toasted sesame seeds in container and label.
recipes.reheating_instructions: Remove container from freezer the night before the day of consumption and place in refrigerator to thaw.  Transfer ingredients to ovenproof baking dish with a lid, and heat, covered at 300 degrees for 20-25 minutes, or until heated through.  Sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds.
recipes.ingredients:
1/4  cup(s) sesame seeds, toasted
1  teaspoon(s) sesame oil, toasted
3  garlic cloves, minced
7 1/2  ounce(s) hoisin sauce
10  ounce(s) orange marmalade
cooking spray
3  pound(s) pork ribs, country-style, boneless

recipes.name: Parisian Gnocchi
recipes.directions:
1. Bring water, butter, and salt to a boil in a medium saucepan over high heat. Add flour all at once and stir with a wooden spoon until a smooth dough forms. Reduce heat to medium-low and continue to stir, beating dough forcefully and rapidly to prevent it from sticking to the pot. Continue cooking until dough pulls away from sides of pot leaving a thin layer and steams slightly.

2. To Finish with Stand Mixer: Transfer hot dough to the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with a paddle attachment. Add mustard and cheese and beat on medium-low speed. Add eggs one at a time, allowing dough to fully incorporate egg before adding the next one. When final egg has been added, add herbs and beat to combine. Transfer mixture to a gallon-sized zipper-lock bag or a pastry bag fitted with a 1/2-inch tip. Proceed to Step 4.

3. To Finish by Hand: Remove pot from heat. Add mustard and cheese and beat with wooden spoon until homogenous. Add eggs one at a time, beating vigorously with each addition to prevent eggs from curdling and allowing dough to fully incorporate egg before adding the next one. When final egg has been added, add herbs and beat to combine. Transfer mixture to a gallon-sized zipper-lock bag or a pastry bag fitted with a 1/2-inch tip.

4. Let mixture rest 15 to 25 minutes at room temperature. Add kitchen twine to both handles of cooking vessel to form a tight rope of sorts above the water. Bring pot of salted water to a simmer and have a rimmed baking sheet. If using a zipper-lock bag, cut off a 1/2-inch opening in one corner. Holding the bag over the boiling water, squeeze the mixture out of the bag, against the kitchen twine to cut off gnocchi into 1-inch lengths and letting them fall directly into the simmering water. Continue cutting off as many as you can in one minute, then stop.

5. When all gnocchi have floated to the top, continue cooking until gnocchi are fully cooked to the center, about 3 minutes longer. Lift gnocchi with a fine mesh strainer or a metal spider and transfer to rimmed baking sheet. Drizzle with a little bit of olive oil and toss to coat. Repeat with remaining dough. Cooled gnocchi can be refrigerated until ready to continue cooking in either the Parisian Gnocchi with Roasted Cherry Tomatoes, Corn, and Zucchini, or in the Parisian Gnocchi Soufflé.
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup (8 ounces) water 
8 tablespoons (1 stick, 4 ounces) unsalted butter 
3/4 teaspoon (about .15 ounces) kosher salt 
1 1/4 cups (6.25 ounces) all-purpose flour 
1 tablespoon Dijon mustard 
1/2 cup freshly grated Parmigiano-Reggiano cheese 
3 large eggs 
2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley leaves 
2 tablespoons finely sliced chives 
Olive oil

recipes.name: Parisian Gnocchi With Roasted Cherry Tomatoes, Corn, and Zucchini
recipes.directions:
1. Adjust oven rack to center position and preheat oven to 300°F. Toss cherry tomatoes in a large bowl with 1 tablespoon olive oil and garlic. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Transfer to a foil-lined rimmed baking sheet and roast until tomatoes are tender and softened, about 20 minutes.

2. Meanwhile, heat 1 tablespoon oil in a large non-stick or cast iron skillet over high heat until lightly smoking. Add corn, season to taste with salt and pepper, and cook, tossing occasionally, until well-browned, about 5 minutes total. Transfer to a large plate and set aside. Wipe out skillet with a paper towel and return to high heat.

3. Add 1 tablespoon oil to now-empty skillet and heat until lightly smoking. Add zucchini and squash and cook, tossing occasionally, until well-browned, about 4 minutes total. Transfer to another large plate and set aside. Wipe out skillet with a paper towel.

4. When tomatoes have finished roasting, remove from oven and set aside. Heat remaining 2 tablespoons olive oil in now-empty skillet over high heat until lightly smoking. Add gnocchi and cook, tossing occasionally, until well-browned on all sides, about 6 minutes total. Add corn, zucchini, squash, tomatoes, and herbs to pan and toss to combine. Transfer to a serving platter or individual plates, top with grated Parmesan cheese, and serve.
recipes.ingredients:
1 pint cherry tomatoes, each tomato split in half 
5 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil 
1 medium clove garlic, minced (about 1 teaspoon) 
Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper 
1 cup fire roasted frozen corn kernels 
1 small zucchini, split in half lengthwise and cut into 1/4-inch half moons 
1 small summer squash, split in half lengthwise and cut into 1/4-inch half moons 
1 recipe Parisian Gnocchi 
2 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley leaves 
2 tablespoons finely chopped chives 
1/4 cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese

recipes.name: P F Chang's Oolong Marinated Sea Bass Copycat Recipe
recipes.directions:
Combine the first six ingredients in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Bring to a boil then reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes. Cool uncovered, then strain out the ginger, garlic, and tea.

Put your sea bass fillets in a storage bag or a covered container with 2 cups of the marinade. Reserve the remaining sauce. Let the fish have a nice soak in the marinade for 5 to 7 hours in the fridge. If the sauce doesn't completely cover the fish, be sure to turn the fillets a couple hours in so that all sides get marinated.

When you are ready to prepare the fish, preheat your oven to 425 degrees F. Arrange the fillets on a baking sheet. Bake the fish for 22 minutes or until the edges of the fillets are starting to turn brown.

Crank the oven up to a high broil and broil fish for 2 to 3 minutes or until you get some dark patches around the edge of the fillets. Just don't let them burn.

As your fish is baking, first start to reheat the reserved sauce on low then heat up a wok or large skillet with one tablespoon of vegetable oil over medium heat. Add the spinach, garlic and baby sweet corn, and a dash of salt and pepper to the pan. Saute the veggies just until the spinach is wilted, then arrange the spinach and corn on each of the four plates.
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups water
2/3 cup soy sauce
3/4 cup light brown sugar
2 teaspoons fresh ginger, minced
1 teaspoon fresh garlic, minced
1/2 teaspoon oolong tea leaves
2 1/2 lbs sea bass fillets (chilean if possible)
1 tablespoon vegetable oil
1/2 lb fresh spinach
1/2 teaspoon fresh garlic
1 (15 1/2 ounce) cans sweet corn
salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste

recipes.name: Pineapple Pie
recipes.directions:
Start with the crust. Place the walnuts, dates and shredded coconut in a food processor. Pulse until you get a nice fine texture. Place the mixture in a non-stick pan and start working it until it shapes into a nice dense crust. Place in the freezer or refrigerator while you move on to the filling.

Place the pineapple chunks, coconut meat, dates and shredded coconut in a blender (or food processor) and blend until you obtain a smooth, creamy consistency. Pour the mixture on the crust, sprinkle a few coconut flakes on top and enjoy!
recipes.ingredients:
**Crust
1 cup of raw unsalted pecans
1 cup of medjool dates
1/4 cup of organic unsweetened dried cherries or cranberries 
1 tablespoon of unsweetened shredded coconut
1/2 tsp ground cinnamon 
**Filling
2 cups of ripe pineapple chunks
1 cup of young thai coconut meat
4 or 5 medjool dates
1/4 cup of unsweetened shredded coconut

recipes.name: Pistacchio Cranberry Cookies
recipes.directions:
Grind the pistachios and walnuts in a food processor outfitted with the “S” blade until coarsely chopped. Loosely separate the dates, then add the dates, cranberries, orange zest and vanilla and process until well mixed or to desired consistency. Do not over process or the oil will separate from the dough mixture.  
Knead dough with gloved hands to mix well.  
To test, place a spoonful of the cookie in the palm of your hand and squeeze gently,  break in half. If the halves hold together well and do not crumble the cookie is finished.  
Using a tablespoon to measure, form small balls and flatten them with your hand,  making cookies about 1⁄2 inch thick and a 1-2 inches in diameter. You can also use a  small melon ball scooper.  
Eat the cookies raw or dehydrate at 115 degrees on a dehydrator tray lined with a nonstick sheet for 12-24 hours, depending on how soft and moist you want them. 
Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to one month or in the freezer for up to four months.
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 cups pistachios, soaked and dehydrated
3/4 cups walnuts, soaked and dehydrated
4 ounces dried cranberries (no added sugar or oil) 
1/2 pound pitted dates, chopped
zest of 1⁄2 large orange, approximately 3 teaspoons 
1⁄2 teaspoon non-alcohol vanilla extract

recipes.name: Potato Gnocchi
recipes.directions:
Preheat the oven to 425 degrees F.
Spread a layer of kosher salt on a baking sheet and arrange the potatoes on top (see Cook's Note). Bake until a bit overcooked, about 45 minutes. Let sit until cool enough to handle, cut in half, and scoop out the flesh. Reserve the potato skins, if desired, for another use.

Pass the potatoes through a potato ricer or grate them on the large holes of a box grater. You should have about 2 cups. Make a mound of potatoes on the counter with a well in the middle, add 3 of the egg yolks, the cheese, nutmeg, salt, and pepper. Mix in the potatoes and mix well with hands. Sprinkle 1/2 cup of the flour over the potatoes and, using your knuckles, press it into the potatoes. Fold the mass over on itself and press down again. Sprinkle on more flour, little by little, folding and pressing the dough until it just holds together, (try not to knead it.) Work any dough clinging to your fingers back into the dough. If the mixture is too dry, add another egg yolk or a little water. The dough should give under slight pressure. It will feel firm but yielding. To test if the dough is the correct consistency, take a piece and roll it with your hands on a well-floured board into a rope 1/2-inch in diameter. If the dough holds together, it is ready. If not, add more flour, fold and press the dough several more times, and test again.

Keeping your work surface and the dough lightly floured, cut the dough into 4 pieces. Roll each piece into a rope about 1/2-inch in diameter. Cut into 1/2-inch-long pieces. Lightly flour the gnocchi as you cut them. You can cook these as is or form them into the classic gnocchi shape with a gnocchi board, ridged butter paddle, or the tines of a large fork turned upside down. Rest the bottom edge of the gnocchi board on the work surface, then tilt it at about a 45 degree angle. Take each piece and squish it lightly with your thumb against the board while simultaneously pushing it away from you. It will roll away and around your thumb, taking on a cupped shape -- with ridges on the outer curve from the board and a smooth surface on the inner curve where your thumb was. (Shaping them takes some time and dexterity. You might make a batch just for practice.) The indentation holds the sauce and helps gnocchi cook faster.

As you shape the gnocchi, dust them lightly with flour and scatter them on baking sheets lined with parchment paper or waxed paper. Set gnocchi filled cookie sheet in front of a fan on low for 1/2 hour (turning gnocchi after 15 minutes). If you will not cook the gnocchi until the next day or later, freeze them. Alternatively, you can poach them now, drain and toss with a little olive oil, let cool, then refrigerate several hours or overnight. To reheat, dip in hot water for 10 to 15 seconds, then toss with browned butter until hot.

When ready to cook, bring a large pot of water to a boil and add salt. Drop in the gnocchi and cook for about 90 seconds from the time they rise to the surface. Remove the cooked gnocchi with a skimmer, shake off the excess water, and serve as desired.

Cook's Note: Baking potatoes on a layer of salt allows heat to circulate 360 degrees. Scrape the salt into a jar and reuse it again and again. If you do not have time to shape the gnocchi, you can freeze the dough, defrost it in the refrigerator, and then shape it. To freeze shaped gnocchi, line baking sheets with waxed paper and dust with flour. Spread the gnocchi on the prepared sheets and freeze until hard. Remove to individual-portion-size freezer bags. Store in the freezer for up to 1 month. To cook, drop the frozen gnocchi into boiling salted water. Cook for about 2 minutes after they rise to the surface.
recipes.ingredients:
Kosher salt 
1 pound russet potatoes 
3 to 4 large egg yolks 
1/2 cup freshly grated Parmesan 
1/4 teaspoon freshly grated nutmeg 
1/2 teaspoon gray salt 
1/4 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper 
1 cup all-purpose flour, plus more for dusting board and dough

recipes.name: Quick and Easy Homemade Ricotta Gnocchi
recipes.directions:
1. Line a large plate with three layers of paper towels. Transfer ricotta directly to paper towels and spread with a rubber spatula. Place another triple layer of paper towels or a clean dish towel on top and press down firmly with the palms of your hands to blot excess moisture. Peel off upper paper towels.

2. Place a large bowl on a scale and zero the scale. Scrape ricotta into bowl to weigh. Remove excess ricotta to leave exactly 8 ounces. Reserve excess ricotta for another use. Add Parmigiano-reggiano, 3 1/2 ounces of flour, whole egg, and egg yolk to bowl. Season with salt and pepper. Combine mixture with a rubber spatula. It should be sticky but not loose. Add flour a tablespoon at a time if it is still very moist after kneading with the spatula for 1 minute.

3. Transfer dough to a lightly floured work surface and dust the top with flour. Flatten into a 4- to 6-inch disk and cut into quarters using a bench scraper. Working one piece at a time, roll dough into a log about 6 inches long, dusting with flour as necessary. Split log in half and roll each half into a log about 12 inches long and 3/4-inch wide. You should end up with 8 logs.

4. Using your bench scraper, cut each log into 8 to 10 gnocchi. using a fork or a gnocchi board drag and flip the gnocchi off and transfer to a parchment-lined baking sheet dusted in semolina flour. Shake to lightly coat gnocchi and prevent sticking. At this point, gnocchi can be frozen. Transfer baking sheet to freezer until gnocchi are completely frozen, about 30 minutes. Transfer gnocchi to a zipper-lock freezer bag and freeze for up to 2 months. Cook directly from frozen, adding a few minutes to cooking time.

5. To cook, bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add gnocchi to pot, stir gently, and cook until gnocchi float for 30 seconds, about 3 minutes total. Drain gnocchi, serve with your favorite sauce!
recipes.ingredients:
12 ounces best quality ricotta cheese (about 1 1/2 cups) 
1 ounce finely grated Parmigiano-Reggiano cheese , plus more for serving 
4 to 6 ounces all-purpose flour (about 1 cup) 
1 whole egg 
1 egg yolk 
Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper 
Semolina flour, for dusting

recipes.name: Roasted Jasmine Tea Rub Ribs
recipes.directions:
1.	In a bowl or pitcher, combine the hot water, tea leaves, salt, and sugar.
2.	Let the mixture sit until it’s cooled and the tea has had a chance to steep. It should look very dark and strong.
3.	Put the ribs in a sturdy 1 gallon Ziploc bag, and pour in the brine mixture.
4.	Squeeze the air out of the bag and seal.
5.	Put in the refrigerator to marinate for 3 hours. Don’t marinate for much longer, or it might be too salty.
6.	Take the ribs out of the bag and brush off any stray tea leaves.
7.	Preheat the oven to 325 degrees F.
8.	In a small bowl, combine the pepper, cumin, paprika, ground tea, and salt, if using.
9.	Brush the ribs thoroughly with a thin layer of soy sauce, and rub the spices all over the ribs.
10.	Transfer the ribs to the oven along with a small heatproof dish filled with water (this prevents the ribs from drying out).
11.	Bake for 1 hour, and brush the ribs on both sides with the honey water.
12.	Bake for another 30 minutes, brush with honey water again, and turn. Raise the heat to 375 degrees F.
13.	Bake for another 30 minutes, remove from the oven, and garnish with toasted sesame seeds and cilantro.
recipes.ingredients:
6 cups boiling water
2 tablespoons dried jasmine tea leaves
2 tablespoons salt
1 tablespoon sugar
1 rack ribs (about 3 lbs)
1 teaspoon black pepper
1/2 teaspoon cumin
1/2 teaspoon paprika
2 teaspoons high quality jasmine tea leaves, ground into a powder in a blender or spice grinder
1/4-1/2 teaspoon salt (add this salt only if your ribs are very meaty)
1 tablespoon soy sauce
2 tablespoons honey, dissolved with 1 tablespoon water
A handful each of toasted sesame seeds and cilantro leaves

recipes.name: Roasted Tofu Lollipops
recipes.directions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees. In a bowl, combine the oil, paprika and salt. Cut the tofu into cubes and gently toss to coat with the mixture. Place each tofu cube in single layer on a baking sheet lined with parchment. Roast for 15 minutes on one side, flip over and roast for another 15 minutes for a total of 30 minutes. Stick a bamboo fork into the side of each cube, top with about 1/2 teaspoon of pesto and serve.
recipes.ingredients:
1 16-ounce block of extra-firm tofu, drained and pressed
1 teaspoon olive oil
1/2 teaspoon paprika
1/2 teaspoon sea salt

recipes.name: Rooibos Cauliflower Mash
recipes.directions:
Steep the tea in the boiling water for seven minutes. 

Cook the cauliflower with the garlic and tea until the florets are very tender. 

Process the cauliflower mixture in a food processor or use a fork to mash it until smooth. Add the butter to the mashed cauliflower and mix to combine. It can either be served as-is for a fantastically flavorful side dish, or if you prefer a creamy, rich texture, add milk or half-and-half until it reaches your desired consistency.
recipes.ingredients:
1 Tbsp loose-leaf rooibos tea
1/2 c boiling water
1 lb cauliflower florets
1/8 tsp garlic powder
1 Tbsp butter
milk or half-and-half, optional

recipes.name: Sage Butter Sauce
recipes.directions:
Cut butter into tablespoon portions, Cook butter in large light colored pot over medium heat stirring constantly, until beginning to brown, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat. Add sage and red pepper.

Toss with pasta of choice.
recipes.ingredients:
6 tablespoons (3/4 stick) butter 
8 large fresh sage leaves, thinly sliced 
1/2 teaspoon dried crushed red pepper

recipes.name: Sicilian Nut Pesto
recipes.directions: Preheat the oven to 350F.  Begin by toasting the nuts on a baking sheet just until golden and fragrant, about 10-12 minutes for the almonds and hazelnuts, and 7-9 minutes for the pistachios and pine nuts.  Set them all aside to cool. Using a towel or moistened hands, rub the skins off the hazelnuts. Combine everything in a food processor except oil and pulse until reduced to a slightly chunky paste then add  oil as needed to get thick paste (might need more or less).  Taste for salt,
recipes.ingredients:
3/4 cup shelled, unsalted pistachios
4 tablespoons pine nuts
3 plump cloves garlic, coarsely chopped
1 1/2 cup (packed) basil leaves, chopped or torn
1 cup (packed) mint leaves, chopped or torn
6 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil
salt, to taste

recipes.name: Spiced American Lamb Meatballs with Tomato Sauce
recipes.directions:
In a medium bowl, combine lamb, eggs, bread crumbs, yogurt, half the parsley, half the cilantro, garlic, ginger, cinnamon and cumin; season with salt and pepper.  Mix well; form into meatballs about the size of a golf ball. 

Heat a large sauté pan over medium high heat; add oil.  Once hot, add meatballs; allow to brown on one side, without moving them, for about 3 minutes.  Gently turn the meatballs to brown the other sides.  Once nicely browned, remove meatballs; add onions to pan.  Cook, stirring often, until onions are softened, about 5 minutes.  Add tomatoes; stir.  Place meatballs back in the pan; bake at 350°F for 15 minutes.

Remove from oven; garnish with remaining parsley and cilantro.
recipes.ingredients:
2	 pounds ground American Lamb
Salt and pepper, to taste
2 eggs
1 	cup bread crumbs
1	 cup yogurt
1/4	 cup chopped parsley, divided
1/4 	cup chopped cilantro, divided
3	 tablespoons chopped fresh garlic
1/2 	teaspoon ground dried ginger
1/4 	teaspoon cinnamon
1/4 	teaspoon ground cumin
1/4 	cup olive oil
4 	onions, thinly sliced
28 	ounces canned tomatoes

recipes.name: Spicy Chili con Carne
recipes.directions:
In the removable cooking pot with the lid off, heat the olive oil and saute the onion and garlic until the onion is wilted using the SAUTE function.
Add the ground beef and cook until it is browned. Mix in the chili powder and salt.
Stir in the crushed tomato, beef stock, peppers and beans.
Close and lock the lid of the Multi-cooker and turn the regulator knob to PRESSURE. Set the timer for 15 minutes on pressure cook HIGH (or for 28 minutes on pressure cook LOW).
Once the cook time is done, release the pressure and remove the lid.
Cook uncovered for 5 minutes on the SIMMER function. Serve in a bread bowl and garnish with sour cream and shredded cheddar cheese.
recipes.ingredients:
2  tablespoon(s) olive oil
2  medium onions, chopped
3  garlic cloves, minced
1 1/2  pound(s) ground beef
2  tablespoon(s) chili powder
salt, to taste
1 1/2  cup(s) crushed tomatoes
1  cup(s) beef stock
1 1/2  cup(s) pinto beans
1  green bell pepper, chopped
1  jalapeno, chopped
1/2  cup(s) sour cream, for garnish
1/2  cup(s) Cheddar cheese, shredded, for garnish

recipes.name: Strawberry Heart Tea Sandwiches
recipes.directions:
Place softened cream cheese, green onion, lemon juice, garlic and cucumber into a food processor. Process until smooth. Stir in sour cream and almonds. Butter bread and spread with cream cheese mixture. Trim crusts and cut into 3 long pieces. Cut strawberries into slices (cut it so that it makes a heart shape). Place a strawberry heart shaped slice on top of the cream cheese sandwich and arrange spinach or basil leaf so that it looks like a stem.
Makes about 32 tea sandwiches.
recipes.ingredients:
3 oz. cream cheese 
3 green onion, chopped 
1 t. lemon juice 
1 garlic clove 
1/2 cucumber 
1/4 c. almonds chopped (optional) 
salt and pepper to taste 
1/4 c. sour cream 
strawberries 
butter 
dark rye 
spinach or basil leaves

recipes.name: Super Green Smoothie Bowl With Matcha and Ginger
recipes.directions:
Soak oats and chia seeds in coconut milk in a small bowl at least 10 minutes and up to overnight. Transfer to a blender and add avocado, ginger, mango, spinach, almond butter, and matcha. Puree until smooth, then divide among 2 bowls. Top with coconut, granola, and/or raspberries and serve.

Do Ahead: To shorten prep time in the morning, soak oats and chia seeds the night before. Assemble all other ingredients except the avocado in a resealable container or blender pitcher and refrigerate overnight. When ready to serve, combine soaked oats and chia, avocado, and refrigerated ingredients in blender and puree until smooth.
recipes.ingredients:
1/2 cup old-fashioned oats
2 teaspoons chia seeds
1 cup coconut-milk beverage or almond milk
1/2 ripe avocado
1 (1-inch) piece fresh ginger, peeled, roughly chopped
1 cup frozen mango cubes
1 cup loosely packed baby spinach
1 tablespoon unsweetened almond butter
1/2 teaspoon matcha (green tea powder)
Unsweetened coconut flakes, granola, and/or raspberries (for serving)

recipes.name: Sweet Tea Brisket
recipes.directions:
1.	In slow cooker combine lemon and onions.
2.	Sprinkle brisket with Worcestershire sauce and steak seasoning.
3.	Place brisket in slow cooker.
4.	Sprinkle with onion soup mix.
5.	In a medium bowl, whisk together BBQ sauce, tea and honey mustard; pour over brisket in slow cooker.
6.	Cover and cook on low heat setting for 8-10 hours.
7.	Transfer brisket to a cutting board; let rest for 10 minutes before slicing.
8.	Using a wire mesh strainer; strain sauce.
9.	Serve sauce with brisket.
recipes.ingredients:
2 large sweet onions, thickly sliced
2 lemons, sliced
3 lb beef brisket, trimmed
1/4 cup Worcestershire sauce
1 tablespoon Montreal steak seasoning
2 packages beefy onion soup mix
11/2 cups honey-brown sugar BBQ sauce
1 cup sweetened lemon flavored tea
1/2 cup honey mustard

recipes.name: Texican Shredded Pork Burritos
recipes.directions:
Heat oil in the PC on BROWN setting. Add onions and jalapeno and cook until soft, about 3-5 min. Add meat in batches and brown, remove and set aside. Add spices, chili powder thru allspice and cook about 1-2 min. Turn the PC off of browning. Add garlic and tomato paste and cook another 1-2 min. (PC will still be plenty hot.) Stir in stewed tomatoes, pork, beef broth and the bay leaves. Set to HIGH pressure for 20 min. Release pressure when finished, remove meat with a slotted spoon to a bowl to cool.
Turn the PC back to browning and allow liquid to reduce to about 1 cup. Taste to add salt and pepper. Allow sauce to cool, remove bay leaves. Shred meat, add sauce to desired consistency and toss with cilantro.
Warm tortillas slightly in microwave, fill with meat and shredded cheese, wrap individually in foil.
recipes.reheating_instructions: Thaw in refrigerator the night before day of consumption. Heat in microwave at medium-low setting until heated throughout.
recipes.ingredients:
1  tablespoon(s) oil
1  small onion, diced
1  small jalapeno pepper, minced
2 1/2  pound(s) pork loin roast, boneless, cubed in 2" pieces
1/2  tablespoon(s) chili powder
1  teaspoon(s) cumin
1/2  teaspoon(s) oregano, Mexican
1/2  teaspoon(s) coriander leaves
1/2  teaspoon(s) thyme
1/4  teaspoon(s) cloves, ground
1/4  teaspoon(s) allspice
2  garlic cloves, minced
2  tablespoon(s) tomato paste
14 1/2  ounce(s) stewed tomatoes
1  cup(s) beef broth
salt and pepper, to taste
2  bay leaves
1/2  cup(s) cilantro
8  flour tortillas, 8" size (Azteca brand)
6  ounce(s) Cheddar cheese, lowfat, shredded (Mexican blend)

recipes.name: Tomato Basil Bisque
recipes.directions: Sauté onions in butter. Add flour, tomatoes, and spices.  Add chicken stock and bring to a boil. Simmer for 15 minutes.  Add honey, cream, parsley, and basil.  Heat thoroughly. Add salt and pepper to taste.
recipes.ingredients:
1/2 c. onion, finely chopped
1/4 c. flour
4 c. tomatoes, finely chopped/pureed
1 t. dill seed
1 t. dill weed
1 t. oregano
3 c. chicken stock
1/4 c. honey
1 c. cream
1/4 c. chopped parsley
1/4 c. chopped basil
4 T. butter

recipes.name: Tomato Cucumber Kabobs
recipes.directions: Throughly wash tomatoes, cucumber and basil. Pat dry. Skewer tomato, cucumber, mozarella and basil leaf. Serve with balsamic vinegar or Italian dressing if desired.
recipes.ingredients:
small cherry tomatoes 
mozzarella pearls or mozzarella slices cut into cubes 
cucumber, cut into slices and quartered 
fresh basil 
freshly cracked pepper 
balsamic vinegar - use a good quality one. 
cocktail toothpicks, the longer the better

recipes.name: Yogurt Cake with Yogurt Glaze
recipes.directions:
Add 2 cups of water to the pressure cooker base, insert steamer basket or rack, and set aside. Lightly oil a wide, shallow 4-cup heat-proof bowl and dust it with flour, knocking out the excess.
Put the yogurt, egg, 3T oil and extract in a small bowl and mix with a fork.  Add the sugar and mix until well combined. Using a fine-mesh strainer, sprinkle the flour, followed by the baking powder and baking soda, over the yogurt mixture and mix together until well blended. Pour the batter into the prepared bowl. Using a foil sling, lower the bowl into the pressure cooker; do not cover the bowl.

Cook at HIGH pressure for 18-20 minutes. When the time is up, open the pressure cooker using the 10-Minute Release method.
Lift the bowl out of the pressure cooker and test for doneness. Transfer the bowl to a wire rack to cool.

Meanwhile make the glaze. Toast the almonds in a dry skillet over low heat and set aside to cool. Put the yogurt in a 2 -cup measuring cup and gradually add the powdered sugar, mixing well with a fork. At first the glaze will seem pasty, but then the sugar will begin to melt and the texture will change, so keep stirring even though at first it may seem like it's not ever going to become liquid. The goal is to achieve a thick creamlike texture. If the glaze seems too wet, add a little more sugar; if too dry, add just a touch more yogurt.

Invert a serving plate over the bowl and flip the bowl and plate over together. Lift the bowl off the cake. Pour the glaze on the center of the cake and let it run down the sides. Sprinkle the almonds over the glaze. Serve the cake cut into wedges, either immediately while the glaze is sticky, or refrigerate first to harden the glaze.
recipes.ingredients:
1  cup(s) powdered sugar, or more as needed
1  tablespoon(s) yogurt
1/4  cup(s) almonds, sliced
1/2  teaspoon(s) baking soda
1 1/2  teaspoon(s) baking powder
2  tablespoon(s) all-purpose flour
1  cup(s) all-purpose flour
1/2  cup(s) sugar
1  teaspoon(s) vanilla extract
1  tablespoon(s) olive oil
3  tablespoon(s) olive oil
1  large egg
2/3  cup(s) yogurt, plain, whole-milk

recipes.name: Italian pork and orecchiette pasta with  spinach
recipes.directions:
Heat olive oil in a large, deep skillet over medium heat. Cook and stir shallot with a pinch of salt in hot oil until is soft and golden, 5 to 7 minutes. Stir sausage into onions; cook and stir until sausage is broken up and browned, 5 to 7 minutes.

Pour 1 1/2 cups chicken broth into sausage mixture and bring to a boil while scraping the browned bits of food off of the bottom of the pan with a wooden spoon. Add orecchiette pasta; cook and stir pasta in hot broth, adding remaining broth when liquid is absorbed, until pasta is cooked through and most of the broth is absorbed, about 15 minutes.

Stir spinach into pasta-sausage mixture until wilted. Stir in parmesan.
Cool, package , label and refrigerate
recipes.description: This orecchiette pasta recipe, melds together delightful flavors.
recipes.reheating_instructions: Heat on stove top- stir in or top with parmesan.
recipes.ingredients:
2 tablespoons olive oil
1 shallot (minced)
salt to taste
19 ounces sweet Italian sausages Johnsonville
4 cups chicken broth
1 pound orecchiette pasta, 
5 oz spinach (chopped)
1/2 cup Parmesan cheese

recipes.name: Walnut and Rosemary Oven Fried Chicken
recipes.directions:
Pound the chicken so that they are about ½ thickness. This is optional but will help the chicken to cook faster.

Combine buttermilk and mustard in a shallow dish stirring with a whisk. Add the chicken to the buttermilk turning to coat.

In a small skillet over Medium heat, toast the panko crumbs until golden brown about 3 minutes. Remove from heat and combine the panko crumbs with finely chopped walnuts, parmesan cheese, rosemary, salt and pepper.

Remove chicken from buttermilk mixture and dredge in crumb mixture.

Arrange a wire rack on a large baking sheet (line the pan with aluminum foil and spray with cooking spray) Lay the chicken on top of rack.

 Garnish with Rosemary leaves.
recipes.description: Get the crispy taste of fried chicken for less than 300 calories with this amazing walnut rosemary crusted chicken!
recipes.reheating_instructions: Preheat oven to 425. Bake for 13-15 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink.
recipes.ingredients:
1/4 cup low-fat buttermilk
2 tablespoons Dijon mustard
4 (6-ounce) chicken cutlets
2/3 cup Panko, crumbs
2/3 cup finely chopped walnuts
4 tablespoon grated fresh Parmesan cheese
1 tbs rosemary
1/2 teaspoon kosher salt
1/2 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper
Cooking spray
Rosemary leaves for garnish (optional)

recipes.name: Baked Chicken and Mushroom Spring Rolls
recipes.directions:
Preheat the oven to 400F.
In a large skillet or wok, sauté the garlic and ginger in the sesame and olive oils over medium heat. Add ground chicken, breaking apart chicken pieces as chicken cooks. When chicken is fully cooked, add mushrooms and slaw mixture to skillet or wok and sauté until mushrooms and slaw mix are just wilted.
Using a slotted spoon and transfer chicken mixture to a large bowl. Make sure liquid is drained from the mixture. Mix in hoisin sauce and scallions until incorporated. Let cool for 10 minutes.
Arrange the spring roll wrappers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Place about 1/4 cup worth of the mixture in the center of each of the spring roll wrappers. Have the wrapper so that a corner is pointing toward you. Spread the mixture outward a little to the left and right side. Then, taking the corner pointing toward you and fold up over mixture to the halfway point. Take the right side of the wrapper and fold in. Take the left side of the wrapper and fold in. Then finally roll the wrapped mixture half away from you until the spring roll is folded.
Brush each spring roll lightly with olive oil to cover the entire spring roll. This means top, bottom and sides. Be careful when picking each roll up since it is not sealed.
Brush top of each spring roll with egg wash.
Bake spring rolls in oven for 15 to 20 minutes until golden brown.
Serve spring rolls with sweet chili sauce.
recipes.ingredients:
1 tablespoon minced garlic
2 teaspoons minced fresh ginger
2 teaspoon sesame oil
1 Tablespoon olive oil, plus more for brushing on rolls
1 pound ground chicken
1 cup pre-shredded slaw mix (cabbage and carrots)
2 scallions, chopped
1 cup shitake mushrooms, stems removed and sliced
2 Tablespoons hoisin sauce
12 square spring roll wrappers
Egg wash (two egg whites in a small bowl)
Sweet chili sauce, for dipping

recipes.name: Latin Chicken Stew
recipes.directions:
1. Place first 6 ingredients in a pressure cooker. Stir in salsa and next 3 ingredients (through pepper). Place chicken on top of vegetables, and add broth. Cover and cook on  hi pressure 25 minutes

2. Remove chicken from cooker; shred with 2 forks. Cool and package it all.
